correctness.rationale: For all 0<r<1, positive Poisson-weighted F_r(b)=∫P_r|1+b e^{it}| is coercive and strictly convex in complex b, hence has unique minimizer real by conjugation symmetry. At c=2r/(1+r²), tangent-half-angle derivative transforms into an integrand antisymmetric under u->h²/u with h=(1-r)/(1+r), making b=-c stationary and therefore globally optimal. Elementary rational square-root decomposition gives the stated nonsingular K/Pi elliptic expression. On the 2D Blaschke model space, exact compression moments m_{0},m_{±1} yield the lower dual bound β>=1/M and the explicit continuous symbol -conj(g)/(M|g|) satisfies all moments with equality; nonvanishing g and Hölder equality give uniqueness. Independent scipy bounded optimization at r=.12,.5,.8 located exactly the stated c to numerical tolerance; independent quadrature verified m_{-1}=-1,m_0=m_1=0 with <1e-9 error. The continuous theorem follows from analytic identities, not three examples.
